title.zh: Claude Opus 5.5：性能提升与成本下降
title.en: Claude Opus 5.5: Faster, Cheaper Frontier AI

excerpt.zh: Claude Opus 5.5主打更强的编码与代理任务能力，并将典型运行成本降低40%；但真实表现仍需独立测试验证。
excerpt.en: Claude Opus 5.5 claims stronger agentic coding at 40% lower typical cost, but independent testing is still needed to confirm real-world gains.

text.zh: Claude Opus 5.5带来更高效的前沿模型体验
text.en: Claude Opus 5.5 targets more efficient frontier-model work

text.zh: Claude Opus 5.5是Anthropic于2026年9月22日发布的Claude 5.5系列首个模型。公司称，它在多数工作中的表现可达到Claude Fable 5.1水平，同时典型工作负载的运行成本比Opus 5低40%，重点面向复杂编码、计算机操作和知识工作。
text.en: Claude Opus 5.5 is the first model in Anthropic’s Claude 5.5 family, announced on September 22, 2026. Anthropic says it reaches the level of Claude Fable 5.1 on most work while costing 40% less to run than Opus 5 on typical workloads. The release is aimed at demanding coding, computer-use, and knowledge-work tasks.

text.zh: Claude Opus 5.5的核心变化是编码效率
text.en: Claude Opus 5.5’s main practical gain is coding efficiency

text.zh: Anthropic公布的测试显示，Opus 5.5在代理式编码、终端任务和多步骤工作流基准中领先Opus 5；部分测试也超过或接近其他前沿模型。它的输入和输出价格分别为每百万token 4美元和20美元，缓存读取为0.20美元，输出速度比Opus 5快30%以上。早期测试者还报告了大型代码迁移、审计和跨仓库任务中的时间与步骤减少，但这些案例不能直接代表所有项目。
text.en: Anthropic’s evaluations place Opus 5.5 ahead of Opus 5 on agentic coding, terminal tasks, and several multi-step workflow benchmarks, with results that sometimes match or exceed other frontier models. Its listed prices are $4 per million input tokens, $20 per million output tokens, and $0.20 per million cached-read tokens. Anthropic also reports output that is more than 30% faster than Opus 5. Early testers described fewer steps and shorter completion times for large migrations, audits, and multi-repository work, although those cases are not universal evidence.

text.zh: Claude Opus 5.5的安全与评测仍需谨慎解读
text.en: Claude Opus 5.5 still needs careful evaluation

text.zh: Anthropic称，Opus 5.5在其自动化行为审计中取得目前最高成绩，并更不容易执行不可逆操作或受到提示注入影响；发布前也接受了外部评估。不过，公司同时承认，在当前能力水平上，基准分差未必能准确预测真实工作差异。部分安全措施在评测中会介入并影响成绩，且长任务、不可完成任务和仿真事故场景的测试仍有局限。因此，企业应结合System Card、实际工作流和人工复核评估，而不应只看排行榜。
text.en: Anthropic says Opus 5.5 achieved its strongest result so far on the company’s automated behavioral audit and is less likely to take hard-to-reverse actions or succumb to prompt injection. The model was also tested by external evaluators before release. However, Anthropic notes that benchmark margins have become less reliable predictors of real-world differences. Safeguard interventions can lower some scores, and evaluations of long tasks, impossible tasks, and incident-based scenarios remain limited. Organizations should therefore review the system card and test representative workflows with human oversight instead of relying on leaderboard positions alone.
